Commentary.Commentary: So 183 is the target for Pakistan to get if they are to keep this series alive. This would be the second-highest run chase by the Men in Green in T20Is if they manage to get it. Can they achieve it? Join us after the break to find out.

The evening started off so well for the hosts with the ball but they were not ready for what was to arrive. There was not much to talk about in terms of Pakistan bowlers' performance. Imad was the pick of the lot picking up a wicket and the only bowler to have an economy of under 7. All the other bowlers ended with an economy of over 7.5.

Bhanuka Rajapaksa - Remember the name! It was a king-like batting performance from him. After winning the toss, Sri Lanka opted to bat and they got off to a very poor start, losing both the openers inside the first 6 overs. It looked like the Lankan batting would succumb under pressure but Rajapaksa and Jayasuriya had other ideas. Bhanuka played the role of an aggressor and Shehan played the role of the anchor. The duo added 94 courtesy of some crisp hitting from Rajapaksa. He looked in the mood tonight and was unfortunate to miss out on a well-deserved ton. But once the partnership broke, Sri Lanka lost two more quick wickets and it looked like Pakistan would make a comeback and restrict the visitors to under 170 but a cameo in the end from the skipper, Dasun Shanaka has taken them to a huge total of 182.
14 runs off the last over and 47 off the last 5 has seen Sri Lanka reach a brilliant total of 182.
Length ball, slower one outside off, Shanaka looks to cut but misses. The batters look to steal a bye but are unable to do so. Sri Lanka end on 182/6.
SIX! Full and on off, Shanaka powers this one straight over the bowler's head, into the sight screen for a maximum. Shanaka, the skipper, with some superb power-hitting here.
FOUR! Risky but it does not matter. Very full down the leg side. Shanaka premeditates the paddle. It takes the bottom edge and goes fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Good running. Full and wide outside off, Shanaka hits it wide of deep point and calls for two straightaway. Wanindu responds and he gets it with ease as the throw is a poor one.
Full toss but it is not punished. It is on off, Wanindu manages to hit it towards long off for just one.
Fast and full on the pads, Shanaka looks to flick but the ball goes off the pads down the leg side for a leg bye.
Mohammad Hasnain to bowl the final over.
On the pads, Shanaka has flicked this one towards fine leg for a single.
Wide! Down the leg side, Shanaka looks to flick this one but misses it. The umpire has signalled a wide.
FOUR! Short ball on middle and leg, Shanaka pulls this one powerfully towards backward square leg for a boundary. Some very useful runs for Sri Lanka here.
On the pads, Hasaranga flicks this one uppishly towards mid-wicket again. Amir gives a shout to catch it but no man there. The batters take one as the fielder in the deep mops it up.

Length ball on off, Shanaka looks to hoick it towards the off side but it comes off the top half and goes towards long on. The fielder in the deep tries to run towards it and catch it but it falls well short. The batters take one.
Short of a length ball down the leg side, Shanaka looks to glance this one down the leg side but the ball hits his hand and it goes towards the keeper.
FOUR! On the pads, Shanaka flicks this one elegantly towards square leg, in the gap and gets a boundary.
Wide! Down the leg side, Shanaka looks to flick but misses. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Mohammad Amir to bowl the penultimate over of the innings. 3-0-27-0, his figures so far.
The new man in is Wanindu Hasaranga.

OUT! TIMBER! That went like a tracer bullet on it's way to dislodging the stumps! Riaz bowls this one on the leg pole line, swinging away from Udana. He looks to smash it down the ground but misses it completely and the stumps behind him are shattered. Another one down for the Lankans and they look to be losing momentum.
Another shorter one, Udana looks to hook but misses this one completely.
Short ball on middle and leg, Shanaka goes for the pull but does not time it well. It goes towards the deep square leg region and the batters take one.
Corker of a yorker this one and Udana does well to dig it out. It goes towards mid off and the batters take one.
FOUR! Short of a length ball on middle and off, Udana makes room and smashes this one over the mid on fielder for a boundary which goes on the bounce and into the fence.
Full ball outside off, Udana looks to flick it towards the leg side but it goes off the leading edge towards third man for a couple of runs.
Floated on off, Udana drives it towards cover and keeps the strike.
Flighted on off, Shanaka milks it to long off and gets to the other end.
Isuru Udana walks out to bat now. He is no slouch with the bat and can hit it to long distances.

OUT! Run Out! Another run out of the innings. Third one to be precise. Sri Lanka kind of losing the ploy here at the end. Flighted on off, Minod drives it to the left of mid off. Wahab Riaz there dives on that side and makes a magnificent stop. Riaz follows it up with a throw to the left of Shadab. Khan gathers the ball and takes off the bails. Bhanuka who was looking for a quick run is well short of his crease.
Floated on middle, Shanaka nudges it to long on and takes a single.
On the pads, Shanaka glances it towards mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Minod Bhanuka walks out to bat now.

OUT! Rajapaksa holes out! What a knock though. He walks out having played a gem of a knock and the crowd here know it. Shadab bowls a flatter one outside off, Rajapaksa moves away from the stump and looks to go over the man at point. He gets the height but not the distance and it goes straight to the man in the deep. Fakhar Zaman in the deep makes no mistake and takes a simple catch. Kudos to Bhanuka. He came in at a tough time but walks back after a gem of a knock.
Shadab Khan is back on.
Short ball this time, Shanaka looks to pull but misses.
The physio is out to have a look at Rajapaksa who has been hit hard on his leg.
Good length ball coming into the batter, it has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads. The batsmen take a quick single.
FOUR! Fuller one outside off, Bhanuka gets down on one knee and creams this one through covers for a boundary.
Good length ball on middle, Rajapaksa comes down the track and smashes it past the bowler. The fielder at long on cuts it off and keeps it down to two.
Skipper, Dasun Shanaka walks out to bat next.

OUT! An anti-climactic end to an awesome partnership. Full and outside off, Jayasuriya pushes this one towards cover and sets off for a run. It goes straight to Asif Ali, he steadies himself and has a shy at the bowler's end and hits. Jayasuriya was miles away and he is disappointed. He has to walk back to the pavilion but he has taken Sri Lanka to a very good position after a supporting knock.
Down the leg side, Jaysuriya looks to flick this one but misses. The ball goes off the pads to Sarfaraz.
Wahab Riaz is back into the attack.
Very full, almost a yorker. Rajapaksa looks to hit it straight but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

FOUR! Hammered away. Rajapaksa was done playing the dots. He comes down the track and he is in such a blistering form tonight that even though Amir bangs it short. He manages to pull it with venom over mid-wicket. It bounces inside the ropes and goes away to the fence.
Slower ball outside off, Rajapaksa swings his bat at it but misses.
Excellent ball. Yorker away from the leg pole. Rajapaksa looks to bring his bat down in time but he is late in doing so.

Better throw and Rajapaksa could have been in trouble. Back of a length ball on off, Rajapaksa pulls it wide of deep mid-wicket and calls for two straightaway. The fielder is slow to get to the ball and he also sends a very poor throw at the keeper's end allowing Rajapaksa to get back with ease.
Fuller on off, Jayasuriya strokes it to deep point for a run.
Sarfaraz gets his strike bowler to try and end the onslaught. Mohammad Amir is back. 2-0-20-0, his figures so far. He has been expensive too this evening.
Length ball on middle, Rajapaksa skips down the track and looks to hit it over the bowler's head but misses it.

SIX! Another one and this one is even better! Length ball on middle and off, Rajapaksa makes room and cuts this one powerfully and aerially over point. Ahmed Shehzad in the deep runs and jumps to his right but cannot stop it from going over the fence.

SIX! Clean as a whistle! Slower one outside off on a good length by Hasnain, Rajapaksa gets his front foot out of the way and just about clears the cover boundary. The umpire raises his arms in the air to signal a six.
Length ball outside off, Rajapaksa looks to cut but misses the line of the delivery.
Length ball on middle, Shehan opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batters take one.
FOUR! That one stays hit! Short of a length outside off, Jayasuriya cuts this one powerfully through the point region for a boundary.
Mohammad Hasnain is back on. 2-0-9-0 his figures in this game so far. He has been one of the few good bowler tonight.
Outside off, Rajapaksa looks to cut but misses again. Too close to cut maybe.
On the pads this time, Rajapaksa flicks this one towards mid-wicket for a couple.
A touch short outside off, Bhanuka looks to cut but the ball stays low and misses the cut of Rajapaksa.
Shehan plays this one towards mid-wicket and the batters take one.
Full and floated outside off, Rajapaksa looks to paddle but misses. The ball goes through Sarfaraz and the batters take a bye off it.
On the pads this time, Jayasuriya glances this one towards fine leg for a single.
Imad Wasim to bowl out. 3-0-23-1, his figures so far.
Length ball outside off to Shehan, he opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
50 FOR BHANUKA RAJAPAKSA! Maiden fifty for Bhanuka this and he looks delighted! Short of a length ball outside off, Bhanuka opens the face of his bat and guides this towards third man for a single.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads. Two runs added to the total.
On the pads, Shehan glances it towards mid-wicket for one.
Back of a length ball on top of off, Rajapaksa runs it down to third man for one.
Length delivery on off, Shehan punches it to the off side and gets to the other end.
Wahab Riaz is back on. 1-0-9-0, his figures so far.
On the pads, Shehan flicks this one towards fine leg and takes a single.  The fielder there has a shy at the stumps and hits but the batter is well in at the striker's end.
Wide!  The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The umpire has signalled a wide.
FOUR! Jayasuriya gets in on the act now! Short of a length ball outside off, Jayasuriya cuts this one towards the cover-point region for a boundary.
Outside off by Shadab, Rajapaksa opens the face of his bat to guide this towards third man as he takes a single.
Touch short outside off, Bhanuka looks to cut but misses.

SIX! This one is a flighted one over mid-wicket and brings up the 50-run stand between these two! Crucial stand for the Lankans. Floated one on middle, Rajapaksa gets down on one knee and slog sweeps this one into the stands.
SIX! Absolute power! Short of a length ball outside off, Bhanuka just rocks onto the back foot and smashes this one over mid-wicket for a flat maximum.
Bhanuka plays this one towards point off the back foot and takes a single. A good over for Pakistan in the context of the game as they concede just 6 runs in this over.
Full one just outside off, Bhanuka lofts this one over the head of the bowler but does not time it properly. The fielder from long on cuts it off and the batters take two.
Length ball outside off, Jayasuriya looks to push this towards the off side but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man for a single.
Length ball on middle and off, Shehan defends this one off the back foot.
On the pads this time, Rajapaksa looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards square leg and the batters take one.
Short ball outside off, Shehan uses the upper cut to guide the ball towards third man for a single. The ball goes on the bounce to the man in the deep.
Oh! That was not far away from finding the outside edge. Short and quick just outside off, Rajapaksa makes room and looks to punch it away. He misses it though, Sarfaraz too fails to gather it.
On the pads, Jayasuriya follows the deft boundary with a flick towards mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Deft touch. Flatter just outside off, Jayasuriya waits for it and plays it very late fine towards the third man region for a boundary.
Flighted on middle, Bhanuka gets down on one knee and slams it to the on side for a single.
Ohh! Flighted on leg, Rajapaksa looks to play the big sweep across the line. The ball though lobs off his pad behind the stumps on the off side.
Flighted on middle, Jayasuriya milks it towards long off for one.
On the pads again, Jayasuriya flicks it towards square leg for a single. He retains strike for the next over.
Fullish this time, Rajapaksa pushes this one towards mid on and takes one.
Length ball on middle and off, defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Wide! Down the leg side, Bhanuka looks to flick but misses again. Sarfaraz dives to his right and collects the ball. Wide signalled.
FOUR LEG BYES! Down the leg side, Rajapaksa looks to flick but misses. The ball kisses his pads and goes towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Length ball coming in, pushed towards mid-wicket.

Good length ball by Hasnain, Jayasuriya pushes it towards mid-wicket and takes off for the single. The fielder at mid-wicket picks it up and has a shy at the stumps. He hits at the bowler's end but Jayasuriya is well in by then. One run added to the total.
Hat-trick hero from the last game, Mohammad Hasnain is into the attack for the first time tonight.
Floated on middle and leg, Shehan sweeps this one but straight to the man at fine leg. The batters take off for a quick single but the misfield from the fielder there makes life easy for the batters.
Shortish just outside off, Rajapaksa cuts it towards point for one.
This time down the leg side, Jayasuriya pushes it towards mid on and takes a single.
Full on the pads, pushed towards long on for a single.
This time on the pads of Rajapaksa, he flicks it wide of square leg. The fielder from deep mid-wicket hares after it but can't stop the batters from taking a couple.
Floated on the pads, the batsman flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Bang this is out of here. Excellent from Rajapaksa. Good length ball on middle and leg, Bhanuka makes room and slashes it over the bowler's head for a biggie. Amir won't like the sight of that.

Another run out chance goes begging. Fuller on middle and off, Shehan strokes it wide of mid off and calls for a quick single. Wahab gets to the ball quickly and attempts a direct hit at the bowler's end. Unfortunately he too misses it.
On the pads, Shehan looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards point.

Sri Lanka are lucky not to be 3 down already. On the pads, Jayasuriya looks to flick, it goes to the right of mid-wicket. Rajapaksa comes out looking to steal a quick single but Shehan sends him back. Babar has a shy at the stumps at the bowler's end but unfortunately he misses.
Follows it up with a sensible front foot defense.

FOUR! Not the welcome Amir would have been looking for. Not much wrong with the delivery it is just brilliant batting. Good length ball around off, Shehan waits on his back foot and slams it through cover point for a boundary.
Shehan Jayasuriya is the new man in. Also, Mohammad Amir is back on.

OUT! RUN OUT! Fernando is out of here! This one is on the pads, Fernando flicks it towards square leg and looks for a quick single. The fielder there gets to it quickly, picks it up and throws it at the bowler's end. Shadab Khan scores a direct hit and the umpire raises his finger straightaway. Avishka doesn't hang around for one second either as he knows he was well short even after his dive. Sri Lanka in trouble now as they have lost both of their openers inside the first 6 overs.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Short of a length ball outside off, cut towards point by Rajapaksa. The fielder from point hares after it and keeps it in play to save a run for his team as the batters take three.
SIX! Full and floated outside off, Rajapaksa gets down on one knee and slog sweeps this one over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Fernando rocks onto the back foot and punches this ball towards cover for a single.
FOUR! Fernando dances down the track to this ball and smashes this one over mid on. Lovely batting this!
FOUR! Slammed away. Rajapaksa comes down the track breaking the shackles. Fuller on off, Bhanuka uses his feet and slashes it over covers for a boundary. 9 off Wahab's first.

Avishka was almost on his way back for an early shower. Good length ball on the pads, Rajapaksa looks to defend but the ball goes off his pads to the side of the pitch on the leg side. Avishka comes forward for a single but Bhanuka sends him back. Wahab gets to the ball quickly and has a shy at the bowler's end. Luckily for Sri Lanka and Avishka he misses.

FOUR! Poor ball from Wahab. It is on the pads, Rajapaksa flicks it wide of the man at short fine leg. The fielder there seems to have misread the ball as he moves to right and the ball goes from his left to the fence.
Beauty! Wahab keeps it straight outside off, Rajapaksa looks to play a flat-bat shot on the off side but the ball cuts him half on its way to the keeper.
Fuller on the stumps, Rajapaksa pushes it back to the bowler.

Good fielding. Pakistan look to be in the mood here. Riaz starts with a good length ball around off. Avishka punches it wide of cover. Fakhar there dives to his right and saves runs for his side. Keeps it down to one.
Wahab Riaz comes on to bowl.
Gives this one air on middle, Avishka strokes it to long on and keeps the strike.
Rajapaksa is off the mark. Imad darts one on the pads, Bhanuka glances it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Floated outside off, Rajapaksa looks to play it on the off side but misses.
Flighted on off, Rajapaksa starts his innings with a calm defense.
Bhanuka Rajapaksa is the next man in for the visitors.

OUT! Caught! Pakistan are up and running. Huge wicket for the hosts as the Man of the Match from the last game is out of here. Imad bowls it around the wicket and creates an angle. He bowls it slightly shorter outside off. It is not wide enough for Danushka to go for the cut. He still goes for it. The ball kisses the outside edge of Gunathilaka's bat and goes straight into the gloves of Sarfaraz Ahmed. The Pakistan skipper takes a sharp catch. The home fans are up in joy and why won't they be.
Floated on off, Gunathilaka pushes it to the man at cover.
Length ball closer to the off pole. Avishka pushes it to the man at cover. Expensive start for Amir. 9 off his first.
Length ball around off, Danushka runs it down to third man for one.
Fuller for the first time. Gunathilaka pushes it to cover.
Good length ball on off, Gunathilaka punches it but straight to cover.

EDGED AND FOUR! Once again Amir hits the deck hard closer to the off pole. The ball moves away just a bit. Gunathilaka has a hard slash at it but the ball takes the outside edge and flies wide of first slip to the fence.

FOUR! Good length ball on off, Gunathilaka punches it with power through covers. Asif Ali gives it a valiant chase and puts in a dive to save the boundary but he touches the rope when the ball is in his hand. The umpire takes it upstairs to check and the replay confirms it.
Mohammad Amir to share the new ball from the other end.
Follows it up with a calm single with a gentle push towards cover for one. 7 runs off the first.

FOUR! Crunched away. That is a stroke of a man in form. Slightly overpitched around off, Gunathilaka smashes it through covers. Babar Azam dives and gets his hand to it but it was so well struck that it did not stop before the fence.
Avishka is off the mark. Floated delivery on middle and leg, Avishka tucks it wide of mid on for one.
Hat-trick of balls on the pads. Avishka glances it towards mid-wicket. He looks for a single but does not get it.
Once again Imad bowls on the pads. Avishka flicks it to square leg but unlike his partner does not get the single.
Sri Lanka are off the mark straightaway. Imad starts with a flatter delivery on the pads. Gunathilaka glances it towards square leg and takes a quick single to get off the mark.

We are all set for the match to begin!  The Pakistan players are in a huddle with their skipper having a last word of motivation to his players before they take their positions in the field. Man of the Match from the last game, Danushka Gunathilaka walks out with Avishka Fernando to open the innings for Sri Lanka. Imad Wasim to start the proceedings for Pakistan with the ball.

Pakistan Playing XI - Fakhar Zaman (IN for Iftikhar Ahmed), Ahmed Shehzad, Babar Azam, Umar Akmal, Sarfaraz Ahmed (WK/C), Asif Ali, Imad Wasim, Wahab Riaz (IN for Faheem Ashraf), Shadab Khan, Mohammad Amir, Mohammad Hasnain.

Sri Lanka Playing XI (Unchanged) - Danushka Gunathilaka, Avishka Fernando, Bhanuka Rajapaksa, Dasun Shanaka (C), Shehan Jayasuriya, Isuru Udana, Wanindu Hasaranga, Minod Bhanuka (WK), Lakshan Sandakan, Kasun Rajitha, Nuwan Pradeep.
TOSS - We are all set for the spin of the coin. Pakistan skipper, Sarfaraz Ahmed has the coin in his hand. Up it goes and comes down in favour of Dasun Shanaka. SRI LANKA OPT TO BAT!

A warm welcome to the coverage of the 2nd T20I between Pakistan and Sri Lanka from Lahore. Today's clash is an important one for both the teams in terms of the series as Sri Lanka leads the three-match series 1-0. It was a one-sided affair a few days back in the 1st T20I, where the visitors humbled the hosts.  Pakistan need to win today to keep the series alive with one game to play. The hosts would be hoping their loss was a one-off and will be eagerly waiting to bounce back today. Their bowlers were guilty of going on a leather hunt the other day and would be determined to correct their flaws and produce a disciplined performance. Their batsmen were seen wanting against the accurate lines and lengths the Sri Lankan bowlers served. On the other hand, Sri Lanka's victory was dominant and authoritative. The Lankan Lions were clinical with their performance. All their departments performed in tandem and that was a boost for them. Gunathilaka was just exquisite with his power hitting and so were the bowlers with their accurate line and lengths. The Islanders might just look to go in with the same winning combination that helped them end their drought on this tour. Whereas, the hosts might also look to tinker with their combination to provide them with the right balance. Will Pakistan bounce back or will Sri Lanka spring a surprise and wrap up the series today itself?  Stay tuned as the toss and team news is not far away.
